versions.changelog:
Initial public release — manage Jira Cloud issues from the command line.

- Search, view, create, update, comment on, assign, and transition Jira issues.
- Uses environment variables for Jira Cloud authentication.
- Outputs all results as JSON for easy parsing.
- Includes commands for listing projects, transitions, and users.
- No jq required; uses python3 for JSON parsing in the OpenClaw container.
